title: Petition to Withdraw Canada's Bill C-22
summary: A Hacker News post highlighting a Canadian Parliament petition (e-7416) calling for the withdrawal of Bill C-22, which amends the Criminal Code regarding conditional sentences and other criminal justice matters. The post received significant community engagement with 443 points and 147 comments.
problem_solved: Raises concerns about proposed changes to Canada's criminal justice system through Bill C-22 amendments.
why_valuable: Demonstrates civic engagement and public discourse on Canadian criminal law reform through direct democracy mechanisms.
